title: 1-on-1 Personal Training
description: Personalized fitness training sessions tailored to your goals and fitness level. I'll work with you to create a customized workout plan that addresses your specific needs, whether you're looking to lose weight, build muscle, improve endurance, or enhance overall health.
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 24 hours before the session for a full refund.
additionalNotes: Please bring water and wear comfortable workout attire. First session includes a fitness assessment.

title: Small Group Training
description: High-energy group fitness sessions for up to 6 participants. Perfect for friends who want to train together or individuals looking for a more social workout experience with competitive motivation.
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 12 hours before the session for a full refund.
additionalNotes: All fitness levels welcome, but some exercises can be modified for beginners.

title: Nutrition Coaching
description: Comprehensive nutrition planning and dietary guidance sessions. Learn how to fuel your body properly, create meal plans that fit your lifestyle, and achieve your health and fitness goals through smart nutrition choices.
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 48 hours before the session for a full refund.
additionalNotes: Sessions conducted via video call. You'll receive a detailed meal plan after each session.

title: Custom Workout Plans
description: Personalized workout plans delivered digitally with video demonstrations. Perfect for those who prefer to train on their own schedule but want professional guidance.
cancellationPolicy: Monthly subscription can be cancelled anytime with 30 days notice.
additionalNotes: Plans are updated weekly based on your progress. Includes access to video library.
